tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search Polyglot Publishing's catalogue of public-domain literature by title, author, genre or theme. Returns books with their euro prices. Leave the query empty to get the most-read titles. Every book can then be produced in any ordered pair of the 44 languages — call list_editions next.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Full details of a single book: complete summary, page count, genres, reading difficulty, year of first publication, and euro prices.

tools.name: get_excerpt
tools.description: A real excerpt of a bilingual edition, as text: each segment in the language being learned, with its translation in the reader's language. Use it to show the user what the book and the line-by-line method look like before buying. Only some titles have an excerpt; the answer says so when one is missi

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: The 44 languages the books can be produced in. Any ordered pair works: the first is the language the reader is learning, the second the one they already know.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: The editions of one book that can actually be produced for a given language pair, with their euro prices and their item_id. Call this before create_checkout_link: it is what rules out the combinations that do not exist — a trilingual edition needs three different languages (it reads in triple column

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Open a Stripe checkout session for one edition and return its payment link. Give that link to the buyer: they enter their card on Stripe's own page, and the ebook is emailed to them once the payment clears. The link expires after 24 hours, and nothing is charged until the buyer pays. For a paperback
